changelog:
Restored supported settings hidden by the USER variant, retaining opt-in, PIN, account and device prerequisites.
Made restored player, theme, display, Sync and WiFi-transfer controls discoverable; search keeps owner callbacks and confirmations.
Restored player mute, frame capture, quick-action selectors, speed controls, subtitle shortcuts and information overlays.
Added owned Scene Bookmark management, session-safe Equalizer controls, reversible Immersive Mode and scheduled themes.
Restored explicit automatic-update opt-in with installation/restart disclosure; preserved manual checking and update-alert semantics.
Fixed invisible native choice lists, saved 4K selection, external-downloader selection and master-dependent rows.
Fixed OFF/player-exit cleanup, stale callbacks and reversible poster geometry; retained compact host-font and Material dialog styling.
Kept unsupported or unwired features disabled; automated tests do not certify hardware playback, audio, capture or TV rendering.
message: restore supported controls, search and lifecycle cleanup renewed
